function ProductCard({ name, price, inStock }) {
    return ( <
        div className = "w-64 p-5 rounded-xl shadow-lg bg-white border hover:shadow-2xl transition duration-300" >

        <
        h2 className = "text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800" > { name } <
        /h2>

        <
        p className = "text-xl font-bold text-blue-600 mt-2" > { price } <
        /p>

        <
        span className = { `inline-block mt-3 px-3 py-1 text-sm font-semibold rounded-full
        ${inStock ? "bg-green-100 text-green-700" : "bg-red-100 text-red-700"}` } >
        { inStock ? "In Stock" : "Out of Stock" } <
        /span>

        <
        /div>
    );
}

export default ProductCard;
